name: OpenRouter Video Upscale
summary: Enlarges your clip 1.5 to 3 times with FLUX Video Upscale through OpenRouter, keeping its length. Billed per megapixel-second of the result.

inputs.label: Your clip
inputs.help: OpenRouter takes the clip only as a web link: while the upscale runs, a random one-off link (a Cloudflare quick tunnel) serves this one file, and it closes when it ends.

inputs.label: Guide (optional)
inputs.help: What the detail should look like, e.g. "sharp skin texture, film grain". Leave it empty to just upscale.

credits: FLUX Video Upscale by Black Forest Labs, through OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/black-forest-labs/flux-video-upscale
notes: Runs on OpenRouter, not on your GPU. Needs cloudflared (CLOUDFLARED or on PATH) for the one-off link to the clip. For a free local upscale, see Video Upscale (SeedVR2) once its models are downloaded.
